title: sample --brief agrees a fact by tool only when its anchor predates the census's phase-2 edits
goal: census.py sample --brief agrees a fact by tool only when its anchor's verified_utc predates the census's phase-2 edits (or the fact line is unchanged since phase 1); every fact re-anchored in phase 2 goes to the checker with its passage, so a reader's rewrite is never agreed by the anchor it wrote.

clauses.clause: census.py sample --brief agrees a fact by tool only when its anchor's verified_utc predates the census's phase-2 edits (or the fact line is unchanged since phase 1)
every fact re-anchored in phase 2 goes to the checker with its passage, so a reader's rewrite is never agreed by the anchor it wrote

notes: Premise: sample_brief and current_passage (_tools/census.py) never read an anchor's verified_utc: a located anchor whose sha is in the page is agreed by tool whatever its date. Premise run 2026-10-12: inspect.getsource shows no 'verified_utc' in either; reproduces. verified_utc is a date only and a census runs in one day, so 'predates' means strictly before the census's phase date (ql_capture.phase_date of the log), or the fact line is unchanged since phase 1; the same-day anchors of phase 2's own re-anchor go to the checker. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 8 of 19, "Census and fact diff: anchor runs write only their own rows, judge confirms are sampled, cost figures are measured"): a lookup returns a wrong or missing fact until it is fixed, which the held-out answer-rate fitness test of EP-gzr4mmkm reads.
